Sault Animal Hospital provides full service veterinary care for the eastern UP and Canada.

Services include:
- Vaccines and Well Pet Care
-Internal Medicine
-General Surgeries
-Orthopedic (broken bones) repair
-Ultrasonography (abdominal and cardiac)
-Digital Radiography
-Emergency medicine
-Large Animal Medicine
-Exotics
